title: D rows are emitted per drop event, not aggregated per (pipe, class, reason) as documented; count column is always 1
evidence: core/stats.odin:76 'Stats_Drop_Row — one per (live member pipe, class, reason) for THIS tick's'; stats.odin:205-221 'for site in state.flow.drop_sites { ... for ps in 0..<len(state.topology.pipe_alive) { ... append(&rec.drops, Stats_Drop_Row{ pipe = state.topology.pipe_id[ps], class = site.class, reason = u8(site.reason), count = 1, }) } }'; flow.odin:725 'event_emit_drop(state, tick, state.flow.packets[shed_idx].class, .Queue_Overflow, b)' (per shed packet); flow.odin:176 'append(&state.flow.drop_sites, Drop_Site{class = class, reason = reason, bundle = bundle})'
detail: drop_sites holds one entry per dropped packet (no count field); a tick shedding N same-class packets on an M-member bundle emits N×M identical D rows with count=1, violating the documented per-(pipe,class,reason) grouping and bloating the diffable artifact.
recommended_fix: Aggregate D rows per (pipe, class, reason) inside stats_compute: accumulate counts per bundle in one pass, then emit one row per (member pipe, class, reason) with the real count.

title: overlay_on App field is not compile-gated despite the comment claiming field + toggle are compile-excluded
evidence: app/main.odin:127 '	overlay_on:  bool,   // 5.7: the D-key debug overlay (PP_DEBUG builds only)' (struct field, outside any `when`); app/main.odin:428-430 '// X/DEL/P/SPACE are taken). PP_DEBUG builds only (the field + this toggle / // are compile-excluded without the define — release builds carry nothing). / when #config(PP_DEBUG, false) {'
detail: Only the toggle and draw call sit inside `when #config(PP_DEBUG)`; the field and its `app.overlay_on = false` init ship in every build. Harmless dead state, but the comment misstates the gating.
recommended_fix: Either wrap the overlay_on field in `when #config(PP_DEBUG, false)` or fix the comment to say only the toggle/draw are compile-excluded.

title: App silently ignores a dangling --stats-out flag with no path token; harness errors loudly on the same input
detail: `app --stats-out` (missing path) silently disables the stream with no diagnostic, against the project's never-catch-and-ignore rule and the harness's loud usage() for the identical malformed invocation.
recommended_fix: When the flag is the last argument, print a usage error and exit non-zero (mirror the harness's strict arity check).

title: stats_check hardcodes /tmp paths — the verb breaks on Windows, a first-class launch target
evidence:
harness/stats.odin:27-28 '	live_path := fmt.aprintf("/tmp/pp-stats-%s-live.csv", demo)
	replay_path := fmt.aprintf("/tmp/pp-stats-%s-replay.csv", demo)'
detail: The replay-identity pin verb cannot write its temp streams on Windows (no /tmp), so the determinism check would fail there. Project targets Steam PC including Windows.
recommended_fix: Use os.get_env("TMPDIR"/"TEMP") with a fallback to the current directory, or write beside the harness binary instead of hardcoding /tmp.

title: overlay_check re-implements the demo stepping loop and frame composition, already diverging from capture_frame's banner placement
detail: The PP_DEBUG verb duplicates ~40 lines of stepping and the capture_frame draw block; the copy already hardcodes banner_y=10, overlapping the health card on health-on demos. Debt grows with each future debug verb.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared run-to-wall-tick helper and an optional overlay parameter or wrapper around capture_frame's composition; at minimum pass health-aware banner_y.
